title: Medical Freeze Allowances by Resort Club Membership Level
content:
A medical freeze is available at every level of Resort Club Memberships. The level decides the fee billed for each frozen month in place of dues, the most frozen months in one membership year and the shortest freeze.

| Membership level | Medical freeze available | Fee per frozen month in place of dues (USD) | Most frozen months per membership year | Fewest months of one freeze | Freeze always starts on the first day of the next billing period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | Yes | 15.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | Yes | 15.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Spa Club Membership | Yes | 25.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | Yes | 25.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Family Resort Club Membership | Yes | 35.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | Yes | 0.00 | 6 | 1 | Yes |

## Quick answers

- **Which level freezes at no monthly cost?** The Founders Resort Club Membership: its fee per frozen month is 0.00.
- **Which level allows the longest freezing in a year?** The Founders Resort Club Membership, with up to 6 frozen months per membership year; every other level allows up to 3.
- **What is the shortest freeze?** 1 month at every level.
- **When does a freeze begin?** At every level, on the first day of the next billing period.
